summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the new Kasir (cashier) feature inside Admin Panel plus regression on public price hiding. All flows passed: admin login, Produk/Kasir tab switching, letter keypad (YVK -> Rp 1.350.000, digits hint '1 3 5'), Z-repeat (QZ -> Rp 9.900.000), backspace, clear, Check Harga Jual reveals margin input, quick chip +250000 -> Harga Jual Rp 1.600.000, buyer modal shows correct price, Barang Terjual form prefilled correctly, save creates sale and switches to Riwayat, summary today_count incremented from 0 to 1, edit prefill works, delete with confirm dialog removes sale. Public regression verified: /katalog page shows no 'Rp' price strings and GET /api/products response contains no 'price' or 'cost_price' fields.
critical_code_review_comments: CashierPanel.jsx is ~430 lines and contains multiple concerns (calculator logic, sell form, riwayat list, modals). Consider splitting into subcomponents (KeypadCalc, SellForm, SalesHistory) if it grows further, but currently acceptable.
In saveSale payload, harga_jual/harga_modal/margin are sent as null when 0 which may be surprising for backend analytics; acceptable given backend already handled.
Buyer modal and Sell form have close buttons without data-testid; edit-from-riwayat requires closing the sell form via Escape+element selector which was slightly fragile in test but worked.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up one TEST_ sale via UI (TEST_Budi / TEST_Sepeda Lipat / TEST-SPD-001) — deleted at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kasir feature fully verified via UI on 2026-01. Public catalog no longer shows price and public /api/products omits price/cost_price fields (confirmed). If retesting, use admin login above, click admin-tab-kasir, and drive keypad via data-testid=cashier-key-<LETTER>.
